$Comment: What lighting the Hollow Lantern pays, once a year. The Hollow Lantern itself is not here:
the yearly keepsake achievement hands it over, so it can carry the year.
The first roll always pays sweets and a Jack Shield, so everyone who lights the lantern can
finish the Hallowed set; Old Jack's stall sells more shields to anyone.
The second roll is a chance on top; Chance is a percent from 0 to 100. The last always pays
festival tokens, which every season pays, through the Currency reward kind.
Name: Hallows_Eve_Lantern_Pay
